name: Jux Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Jux Bar in Tirol!** Discover the heart of fun and tradition in the **Alps** at our cozy **Jux Bar**, nestled in the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a cold **Tiroler Bier**, a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, or just a good laugh with friends, we’ve got you covered. **Come on in—let’s make some memories!** --- **

Why Visit Us?

** - **Authentic Atmosphere:** Step into a rustic **Tiroler** hideaway where the walls whisper tales of mountain adventures. - **Local Flavors:** Savor classic dishes like **Tiroler Gröstl**, **Obatzda**, and **Apfelstrudel**—all made with love. - **Great Vibes:** Live music, board games, and a warm welcome await you every day. --- **

Location:

** Right in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short stroll from **Innsbruck**’s bustling center. Easy access from **Zirl**, **Hall in Tirol**, and beyond! --- **

Opening Hours:

** **Monday–Thursday:** 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM **Friday–Saturday:** 11:00 AM – 2:00 AM **Sunday:** 10:00 AM – 12:00 AM --- **

Pro Tip:

** Pair your **Tiroler Schnaps** with a view of the **Nordkette**—trust us, it’s a match made in heaven! --- **

See You Soon!

** **Jux Bar – Where Every Visit Feels Like a Holiday!** 🏔️🍻
